text_block_list.text:
Day of race. Arrived to spectate,
found commotion near course.

Contender Hishi Amazon and another horse girl
appeared to be talking...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, 1-on-1 showdown between us!
Hit me with everything you got!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh. She's been in slump lately.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Told her: 'Just run thinking about crushing me.'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, Big Sis Hishi Ama ain't losing!
Cheer if you feel like it. Later!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Big Sis Hishi Ama!
I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Great look in your eyes!
Alright, let's brawl for real!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: (Heh... running much better now.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Time to break out from dead last and catch up—
alright, now!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ten thousand years too early to block Big Sis Hishi Ama!
UWOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
No way!?
Pulling awayyyy...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon! Hishi Amazon takes 1st place!
Surging from absolute back in final stretch,
miraculous comeback victory!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh!
How's that...!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Total defeat. But thanks to your advice, Big Sis,
broke out of slump!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Glad to hear. Your run had crazy fire!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whenever hitting wall from now on,
stop overthinking and smash right through!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Path'll open right up!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yes, Big Sis!
